app.title: Ghostty 1.4
app.author: deaux
app.description: Ghostty is a fast, lightweight terminal emulator written in Rust, focusing on speed and low resource usage.
proposed_tests: Install Ghostty via cargo install ghostty
Start ghostty, open a shell, execute a simple command like ls, measure startup time
Run ghostty in headless mode if available and check exit status
Compare startup time against a baseline terminal like xterm
